youtube_title: Bad Breath Even After Brushing? You Missed One Spot | Body Fix #39 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #39. Brushed this morning... still BAD BREATH? And your friend's backing away?
B is right. Clean your TONGUE. Bacteria live there.
Less saliva at night: bacteria build up on the tongue and between teeth.
Fix: Scrape your tongue, clean between teeth, drink water, dentist check-up.
Red flags: Bleeding gums, tooth pain, or smell that never goes? See a DENTIST.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Bad breath
